name: Emma Ytterell - Article 14, après le § 2 - Am 127
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: 2a. Member States may, through the competent national authority, classify projects for energy generation, energy storage, and energy transmission and distribution within their territory as strategic on the basis of objective and published criteria, provided that they contribute significantly to the security of energy supply. Such classification shall be carried out by the Member State without prior approval or confirmation by the Commission. Security of energy supply includes, in particular, a reliable, affordable, and continuous supply, sufficient secured generation capacity, grid stability, and storage and transmission capacity. The designation shall be made regardless of the technology used and may, in particular, cover nuclear energy as well as other dispatchable generation technologies, storage, and grids. Sections I, II, and III of the Annex also apply to those projects in accordance with the conditions set out therein. The application of the Annex pursuant to this paragraph requires neither a determination under paragraph 1 nor a reference under paragraph 2. The conditions set out in paragraphs 1 and 2 regarding a contribution to resilience and decarbonisation or to resource efficiency shall not apply in this context. When conducting the review pursuant to Section I of the Annex, the competent authority shall give special consideration to the project’s contribution to energy supply security and shall assess on a case-by-case basis whether the requirements of the directives specified therein are met.
